name: Sister Scheme ~Onee-chan to no Shikata ni Tsuite~
original_name: しすたー・すきーむ～お姉ちゃんとのシかたについて～
source: Anjou Sakito is a normal high school student. He is in love with the president of the public morals committee, Kusaka Isami, who is also a classmate. His blood related sister Anjou Marine is in love with him though. One day at school she gets horny while talking to Sakito, and she ends up masturbating in the toilet. Later that day Sakito gets a letter containing a picture of this event and instructions he has to follow if he doesn't want the pictures spread. The first instruction is to take a picture of him kissing his sister in front of the school's gates.
translation: 安城崎人是一名普通高中生。他和同班同學、風紀委員長日下勇美兩情相悅。但他親姊姊安城萬里音卻愛上了他。有一天，她在學校與崎人交談時一時性慾高漲，最後她在廁所裡自慰。當天稍晚，崎人收到一封信，裡頭夾著她自慰的照片，並寫明他若不想照片外流，就得照指示行動。第一個指示是在學校門口拍一張他親吻姊姊的照片。
